llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set `lazy` to `true` on tab screens so non-visited tabs are rendered only on first visit.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `lazy` prop is set to `true` on any tab screen config. The use of `React.lazy` for component code-splitting is unrelated to the React Navigation `lazy` screen option that controls deferred rendering of non-visited tabs.
evidence: screens: { Home: HomeScreen, Search: SearchScreen, Profile: ProfileScreen }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define `initialRouteName` on the bottom tab navigator to make the initially rendered tab explicit.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `initialRouteName: 'Home'` is explicitly set on the `createBottomTabNavigator` config object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement tabs with `createBottomTabNavigator` (not stack/drawer/top-tabs) for this flow.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `createBottomTabNavigator` from `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs` is imported and used to create the navigator.
